statements.impact_statement: The advisory describes command injection in the SQLite command-line shell .recover command, not the SQLite shared library. The EvidencePilot Business and Inference runtime images include the SQLite shared library as a Python runtime dependency but do not install or execute the sqlite3 CLI or its .recover command. This assessment is limited to the sqlite-libs package in these runtime images. If a future image adds the sqlite3 CLI, this VEX statement must be re-evaluated and must not be applied to that component.
